feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: From Proof of Principle to Therapeutic Discipline: Strategies to Improve the Benefit/Risk Profile of Amyloid-Targeting Treatments for Alzheimer's Disease.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗已确立疾病修饰地位，但获益风险比窄，需优化策略以提升临床净获益。

drug.title: Anti-Amyloid Antibodies in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease: An Umbrella Review.
drug.zh: Lecanemab与donanemab可延缓认知衰退并清除β淀粉样蛋白，但ARIA风险需权衡。

drug.title: APOE-stratified genome-wide association analyses provide insights into the genetic etiology of Alzheimers's disease.
drug.zh: 按APOE基因型分层全基因组关联分析，揭示AD遗传病因及ε4/ε2效应机制。

drug.title: The path to treating multiple-etiology dementia: Combining vascular risk control and disease-modifying neurodegenerative therapies.
drug.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the A
drug.zh: 多病因痴呆需血管危险控制与抗淀粉样蛋白等神经退行性修饰治疗联合，单通路试验模式已不足。

drug.title: Baseline plasma C1q and C3 as potential biomarkers for lecanemab efficacy and ARIA risk in early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 基线血浆C1q和C3可预测早期阿尔茨海默病中lecanemab的疗效及ARIA风险。

drug.title: In brief: Subcutaneous lecanemab (Leqembi Iqlik) for initial treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
drug.journal: The Medical letter on drugs and therapeu
drug.zh: 皮下仑卡奈单抗用于阿尔茨海默病初始治疗，疗效与静脉给药相当且更便捷。

drug.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗需警惕脑淀粉样血管病等脑血管共病，试验筛选偏倚限制其真实世界适用性。

drug.title: Conformational modulation and inhibition of lysozyme amyloid fibrillation by lanthanum-doped red carbon dots: a multispectroscopic, morphological, and molecular simulation study.
drug.journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular a
drug.zh: 镧掺杂红碳点通过氢键和范德华力结合溶菌酶非催化表面口袋，抑制其淀粉样纤维化。

mech.title: Genetic and molecular evidence linking CTSH to Alzheimer's disease pathophysiology.
mech.zh: CTSH的rs2289702变异通过顺式调控升高其表达，与更好认知和更少淀粉样斑块相关，支持其神经保护作用。

mech.title: Alzheimer's Disease in the Era of Geroscience: Mechanisms, Biomarkers, and Therapeutic Prospects.
mech.zh: 抗Aβ抗体仅轻度延缓早期AD，提示需以衰老八标志为框架联合靶向tau与胶质反应。

mech.title: Efficacy of Low Dose of Dihydroquercetin (DHQ) in Two Genetic Models of Neurodegeneration: Insights from FUS[1-359]-Tg and APPswe/PS1dE9 Paradigms.
mech.zh: 低剂量DHQ虽改善APP/PS1小鼠行为并减少淀粉样斑块，但在FUS[1-359]模型中无效。

mech.title: The Ocular Microbiome and Alzheimer's Disease: Emerging Insights.
mech.zh: 眼表微生物组与AD的关联尚属假说，其经眼-脑轴参与AD病理的可能有待严格验证。

mech.title: Photobiomodulation with 808 nm Laser Light Repairs Mitochondrial Integrity and Normalizes ROS, ATP, and Membrane Depolarization in Aβ-Exposed Primary Neurons in Alzheimer's Disease Model.
mech.zh: 808 nm光生物调节通过修复Aβ暴露神经元的线粒体完整性并恢复正常ROS、ATP及膜电位发挥神经保护作用。

mech.title: Caenorhabditis elegans as a Model for Studying Nrf2/SKN-1 Activation in Alzheimer's Disease: Plant Bioactive Compounds and Therapeutic Translation.
mech.zh: 线虫模型证实植物活性物经SKN-1/Nrf2通路抗阿尔茨海默病氧化应激，具转化潜力。

mech.title: HIF-2α Depletion and HIF-1α Overexpression in Vulnerable Brain Regions Distinguish Alzheimer's Disease with Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy.
mech.zh: AD伴CAA者海马易损区HIF-2α缺失、HIF-1α过表达，而ACC区HIF调控相对保留。

mech.title: Apolipoprotein E Alleles Across the Spectrum of Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mech.zh: APOE4增加额颞叶痴呆风险但远弱于阿尔茨海默病，APOE2则呈相反模式。

dx.title: Digital cognitive phenotyping enhances risk stratification in preclinical Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 在Aβ阳性临床前AD中，数字认知表型可分四类，显著提升近端认知下降与CDR进展的风险分层。

dx.title: Plasma Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein and Neurofilament Light Chain Concentrations Are Inversely Associated with Retinal Microvascular Perfusion and Vessel Density in Cognitively Normal Individuals with Familial or Genetic Risk Factors for Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 在认知正常但具阿尔茨海默病家族或遗传风险者中，血浆GFAP和NfL越高，视网膜微血管灌注与血管密度越低。

dx.title: Plasma p-Tau217 and SPECT-Based eZIS in Mild Cognitive Impairment: Concordance Analysis with Validation in an Amyloid PET Sub-Cohort.
dx.zh: 血浆p-Tau217与eZIS在MCI中显著一致，且经淀粉样PET亚组验证。

dx.title: Real-world anti-amyloid therapy beyond traditional symptomatic populations: a longitudinal case series.
dx.zh: 真实世界三例抗淀粉样蛋白治疗显示，临床与生物标志物轨迹因基线特征和治疗时机而异。

dx.title: Evidence for similar enzymatic but different cellular generation of pE79-modified α-synuclein in PD and AD mouse models.
dx.zh: PD与AD小鼠模型中pE79-αSyn的酶促生成机制相似，但细胞来源不同。

dx.title: Chronic kidney disease and cognitive decline: choroid plexus remodeling, glymphatic dysfunction, and alzheimer biomarker interpretation.
dx.zh: 慢性肾病认知障碍源于脉络丛重塑与类淋巴功能障碍，并干扰阿尔茨海默病生物标志物解读。

dx.title: Expression differences and diagnostic efficacy of core plasma biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease, cerebral small vessel disease and healthy adults.
dx.zh: 血浆p-Tau217和GFAP在AD与CSVD及健康人间差异显著，对AD诊断及两者鉴别效能最优。

dx.title: Sociodemographic and clinical characteristics of participants in blood p-tau217 studies for Alzheimer's disease: A systematic review.
dx.zh: 血p-tau217诊断AD的研究人群多集中于记忆门诊和高度选择样本，社会人口学与临床特征报告不足，代表性存疑。

prev.title: APOE4 moderates the association of sleep disturbance with cerebral amyloid burden but not with clinical conversion in cognitively normal older adults.
prev.zh: APOE4携带者中睡眠障碍与脑淀粉样负荷相关，但不影响临床转化。

prev.title: Incidence of dementia and mild cognitive impairment in two Indigenous Bolivian cohorts.
prev.zh: 玻利维亚亚马逊原住民队列痴呆发病率仅7.4/1000人年，患病率持续低于2%，且APOE ε4等风险因素作用有限。

prev.title: Genetic and molecular evidence linking CTSH to Alzheimer's disease pathophysiology.
prev.zh: CTSH的rs2289702变异通过上调溶酶体蛋白酶表达，与更好认知和更少淀粉样斑块相关，支持其神经保护作用。

prev.title: Vitamin D and Health: Establishing Causal Relationships Through Observational Evidence and Hill's Criteria in a Biological Framework.
prev.zh: 维生素D作为营养素不宜套用药物RCT范式，长期前瞻性队列与生态学研究结合Hill标准可确立其慢性病预防的因果证据。

prev.title: Association of Physical Activity with Psychological Distress and Poor Mental Health Days Among Informal Caregivers of Older Adults: Findings from the 2023 BRFSS Caregiver Module.
prev.zh: 2023年BRFSS数据显示，从事体育活动的老年照护者心理困扰和不良心理健康天数显著更少。

prev.title: From Sensory Deprivation to Psychosis: Environmental Mechanisms of Delirium in Dementia-An Eight-Year Retrospective Longitudinal Case Report and Narrative Review.
prev.zh: 感觉剥夺与环境不稳定可独立于急性医学诱因，反复触发晚期阿尔茨海默病患者的谵妄乃至精神病。

prev.title: Association between fear states and cognitive impairment: A cross-sectional observational study based on the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS).
prev.zh: 基于CHARLS数据，恐惧状态是中老年人认知障碍的独立相关因素。

prev.title: Reading and associations with brain health, cognition, well-being, and mental health.
prev.zh: 终身阅读爱好可提升认知储备、改善脑健康与心理健康，并降低认知衰退风险。

intro.title: A new era of genome-wide association studies in the field of Alzheimer's disease and overlapping co-pathologies: lessons learned from a neuropathology-centered approach.
intro.zh: 科学家正用大脑解剖代替看病诊断来找出更多老年痴呆相关基因，帮我们更早看清病因、找到新药方向。

intro.title: Caenorhabditis elegans as a Model for Studying Nrf2/SKN-1 Activation in Alzheimer's Disease: Plant Bioactive Compounds and Therapeutic Translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是科学家用线虫这种小虫子来测试植物里的天然成分能不能激活人体的抗氧化开关，从而帮我们对抗老年痴呆。

intro.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
intro.zh: 抽血查几个指标就能提前筛出大脑里还没症状的阿尔茨海默病风险，帮新药试验更快找到合适的人。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆可能是一根藤上的两个瓜，控好血糖、护好大脑，或许能帮我们老得慢一点、糊涂得晚一点。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 治阿尔茨海默病的新药虽能清脑内斑块，却可能让脑血管变脆、引发脑水肿或出血，这篇综述告诉普通人用药前要查脑血管、用药后防中风。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用人的干细胞在培养皿里造出迷你大脑，专门研究大脑里的“保安细胞”怎么在老年痴呆中帮倒忙，帮我们找新药。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是抽血查阿尔茨海默病的新方法，比腰穿和脑扫描更便宜、少受罪，有望让普通人早发现早干预。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑里的“清洁工”细胞在阿尔茨海默病中会变坏、引发慢性炎症，并梳理了针对它的新疗法思路，帮普通人看懂这病为何难治、新药在往哪走。
